subject: Sharing POC metrics & quick ask: advocate quote / 20-min call?
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Turner <leah.turner@acmeplatform.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sharing POC metrics & quick ask: advocate quote / 20-min call?

Hi Leah —

Thank you again for running the POC with us last month. The engineering team at Acme was awesome to work with and we learned a lot about the production traffic shape you run. I put together a short one-pager with the high-level outcomes (attached) but wanted to surface the key numbers here so the execs have them quickly: 

- 95th pct tail latency at 8k token sequences dropped from ~2.1s to ~1.2s (≈42% improvement)
- Token cost per request reduced by ~31% after enabling prefix KV caching and the recommended quantization profile
- Average throughput improved from 120 reqs/min to 190 reqs/min under the same GPU pool size

Those wins are exactly the kind of production improvements we aim for and we hope it’s been helpful for the Acme team. If you’re willing, we’d love two quick things that help us a lot: 

1) A 20-minute recorded call (just a candid customer advocate chat) we can reference in a short case study; and
2) A one-line quote we can use (attribution to Acme Platform + job title OK) and permission to include the Acme logo on a customer page.

We can run the 20-min conversation as a quick recap — no slide deck necessary. If you prefer, Marissa can draft a short quote and we’ll send it over for approval.

Attached: redwood-poc-onepager.pdf (one-page summary), poc-metrics-chart.png (small chart).

Would Nov 30th work for a 20-min slot? Rishi (cc’d) will help coordinate. Thanks again — big thanks to David and the infra team for the tight collaboration.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
-----
Attachment: redwood-poc-onepager.pdf (PDF, 280 KB)
Attachment: poc-metrics-chart.png (PNG, 120 KB)

From: Leah Turner <leah.turner@acmeplatform.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Huang <david.huang@acmeplatform.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sharing POC metrics & quick ask: advocate quote / 20-min call?

Hi Hannah —

Really appreciate the clear summary and the one-pager. The metrics align with what our telemetry shows — the caching helped a lot on the heavier prompt templates. Happy to help.

We can do a 20-min advocate chat and I’m fine with a one-line quote. David (cc’d) will be the technical lead on this from our side and can join. 

Proposed: Nov 30th, 3:00 PM PT for a quick call. If that works for you all, please send a calendar invite and we’ll confirm.

Quick note for the quote: we prefer wording that mentions predictable latency improvements and production reliability rather than exact percentages in public marketing.

-Leah

Thanks — calendar invite sent for Nov 30th, 3:00 PM PT (Zoom link included). We’ll record the session for internal use and to make it easier for marketing to pull quotes.

The team put together a suggested one-line quote based on what Leah said and the outcomes we measured. Feel free to edit — this is just prose to make approvals quicker:

"Working with Redwood Inference reduced our tail latency and made inference performance more predictable in production, which let us scale downstream services with greater confidence."

If that looks good to you, simply reply with a one-line approval and indicate whether we can include the Acme Platform logo on a short customer blurb. If legal needs to review logo usage, cc their contact on the reply and we’ll route it through our marketing ops.

Looking forward to the chat.
